subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some students stayed late playing games, and older residents complained about noise.”?
options: New systems may be efficient, but they must still leave room for people who are learning.
The village added rules: quiet hours, study tables, and a helper desk for people learning to use phones.
It also started teaching people how to use e-books on their phones and tablets.
City Hall added a chatbot to answer common questions about trash pickup, parking rules, and public services.
